summary: Iteration 25: Tested 3 Collection Sheet FY-calculation bug fixes for net-off combined loan rows. All 18 backend tests PASS. Frontend smoke test PASS. RA0022 Kusum Kumari row verified in UI for FY 2022-23 (Bal=₹18,000) and FY 2023-24 (पिछली बाक़ी=₹18,000/Dec 2022, किस्त हाल=blank).

feature_tests.FY_2022_23_RA0022_outstanding_balance_18: PASS — outstanding_balance=18000.0 for RA0022 in month=2023-03 (FY 2022-23). L2 disbursed Dec 2022 is within FY 2022-23, so new_loan_in_fy=True and prev_opening_balance=L1 netoff residual (10000). Bal column correctly shows ₹18,000.
feature_tests.FY_2023_24_RA0022_prev_opening_balance_1: PASS — prev_opening_balance=18000.0 for RA0022 in month=2024-03 (FY 2023-24). L2 disbursed Dec 2022 is BEFORE FY 2023-24 start (Apr 2023), so l2_before_fy=True → uses L2's own opening_balance=18000.
feature_tests.FY_2023_24_RA0022_prev_loan_date_Dec2022: PASS — prev_loan_date='2022-12-15' starts with '2022-12'. Frontend formats this as 'Dec 2022' in पिछली बाक़ी column.
feature_tests.FY_2023_24_RA0022_new_loan_in_fy_False: PASS — new_loan_in_fy=False for RA0022 in FY 2023-24. Frontend correctly renders किस्त हाल column as blank (no value shown).
feature_tests.FY_2023_24_RA0030_new_loan_in_fy_True: PASS — RA0030 L2 loan_date=2023-08-15 (within FY 2023-24 Apr 2023–Mar 2024), new_loan_in_fy=True. किस्त हाल shows L2's total_repayable with ↩ date.
feature_tests.current_FY_all_combined_rows_have_new_lo: PASS — 11 combined rows found in FY 2025-26 (month=2025-04). All have new_loan_in_fy field present. RA0006 L2=Jun 2025 correctly has new_loan_in_fy=True.
feature_tests.frontend_smoke_collection_sheet_loads: PASS — /collections page loads, sticky header visible, FY selector works, 8 misal sections shown (Rampur Testing).
feature_tests.frontend_fy_selector_switch: PASS — FY selector switches from 2026-27 to 2023-24 correctly; FY badge updates to 'FY 2023-24 · Apr 2023→Mar 2024'.
feature_tests.frontend_kusum_kumari_row_display: PASS — Kusum Kumari row in FY 2023-24 shows: पिछली बाक़ी=₹18,000/Dec 2022, किस्त हाल=blank, Bal=₹16,000. UI confirmed visually.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend logic is correct: l2_before_fy check at line 330 correctly uses row_loan_ym < fy_months[0] to determine if L2 was disbursed before the viewed FY.
new_loan_in_fy=False initialized at row construction (line 249) ensures field is always present on all rows, not just combined ones.
Frontend showNew logic at CollectionSheet.jsx:435 correctly uses row.new_loan_in_fy === true without the old || row.is_netoff_combined override.
Frontend पिछली बाक़ी column at line 419 correctly uses fmtLoanDate(row.prev_loan_date) for combined rows.
Case B (parent not in current FY rows) also correctly applies l2_before_fy logic for cross-FY visibility.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Used existing RA0021-RA0030 net-off seed data in Rampur Testing illaka.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 25: Net-off combined row FY-calculation fixes fully verified. Key behaviors: (1) FY 2022-23 with RA0022: outstanding_balance=18000 (Bal column), new_loan_in_fy=True (L2 Dec 2022 is within FY), किस्त हाल shows L2's total_repayable. (2) FY 2023-24 with RA0022: prev_opening_balance=18000, prev_loan_date=2022-12-15, new_loan_in_fy=False → किस्त हाल blank. (3) RA0030 L2=Aug 2023 in FY 2023-24: new_loan_in_fy=True → किस्त हाल shows L2 total_repayable. (4) All 11 combined rows in FY 2025-26 have new_loan_in_fy field. Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_collection_sheet_netoff_fy.py (18 tests).
rca_of_issue: 3 bugs fixed: (1) FY 2022-23 Bal was wrong because outstanding was calculated incorrectly for netoff-combined rows — fixed by proper paid_through_fy_end calculation. (2) FY 2023-24 पिछली बाक़ी was L1 residual (wrong) instead of L2's own opening balance — fixed by l2_before_fy check: if L2 was disbursed before the FY, use L2's opening_balance and loan_date. (3) किस्त हाल was always shown for netoff-combined rows (via old || override) even when L2 wasn't new to the FY — fixed by removing that override and using new_loan_in_fy===true strictly.
